text: パントマイムで　つくったカベが　ほんとうに　あらわれるという。

structure.jp: パントマイムで　つくったカベが
structure.en: the walls it made by miming

structure.jp: ほんとうに　あらわれるという。

patterns.name: 〜という (hearsay)
patterns.explanation: という at the end of a sentence means 'it is said that', passing on what people say. あらわれるという = 'it is said that they appear'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: パントマイムで　つくったカベ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb sits right before a noun and tells you which one. パントマイムで　つくったカベ = 'the walls it made by miming'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here shows the way something is done. パントマイムで = 'by miming'.
